description: This file contains shell functions for the upgrade process of Linksys devices within the OpenWrt project. It handles determining the current firmware partition, switching boot partitions, and performing the upgrade via UBI or direct flash writes.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition (kernel2 or kernel1) based on current boot settings and UBI information.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for Linksys devices, handling partition selection, UBI management, and flashing based on the provided firmware image.
